_comment_ChatReactionPack: Deliberately no context entry below for 'ChatReactionPack': those aliases resolve to full-color Noto Emoji SVGs (see thirdparty/noto-emoji/), which must render byte-identical in both themes. SvgIcon::loadFromData() recolors an icon only by literal string-replacing 'currentColor' tokens against a context's 'modes' map (src/svgicon.cpp); a context with no 'modes' block gets an empty color map and the SVG passes through untouched. Do NOT add a 'modes' block for 'ChatReactionPack' here or in dark/chatreactions.json.
